items.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe... talking with Josephine Davies

ctx.x: Josephine was interviewed via Zoom on October 14, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive in Central New York, and I’m pleased to be talking with Josephine Davies in England. Welcome.
Thank you, Monk. It’s great to be here.
